title: The certificate in the hall
logline: A certificate the shop framed in 2005 — what for, the page won't say — in a school hallway in 2024 among forty others, its frame the only one with a mat. The kids passing it don't look. The page looks for them.

panels.composition: A school hallway wall with forty framed certificates in rows, one of them with a cream mat the others lack, students' backs passing beneath, none looking.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a school hallway wall with rows of framed certificates one of which has a cream mat the others lack, students seen from behind passing beneath without looking, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
